meta.title: feat: add ESLint rule to prevent AppRouter source imports
meta.body_summary: Add custom ESLint rule to flag and auto-fix imports of AppRouter from source to use generated types path for better performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added an ESLint rule for perf-oriented import enforcement; maintainer closed PR without review or comment after 47 minutes.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new ESLint rule `avoid-app-router-source-import` that flags and auto-fixes imports of AppRouter from `@calcom/trpc/server/routers/_app` to use `@calcom/trpc/types/server/routers/_app`. Registered in rules index and enabled at error level in recommended config.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (`8a66b02`): added rule implementation (44 lines) and registrations.
Follow-up commit (`35c37db`): updated rule implementation (20 additions, 14 deletions).
